author: Dan; implementation by Codex
selection: Use only prior training data. Among safe eligible setups with >=1 USDT after fees, rank estimated grid rates. Replace at most the worst incumbent per hour only if a higher-rate challenger has positive projected grid-income advantage after opening and executable closing costs over the configured horizon. Fixed capital/leverage are never swept.
volatility_candidate: 100*(24h_high-24h_low)/24h_low; NOT verified as KuCoin UI definition
execution_limits: No runtime, installed scheduler, account login, order API or live recommendations.
OHLC-generated fill ledgers are simulations, not observed KuCoin trades.
Snapshot calibration cannot recover unknown original quantities or margin amendments; never fit each symbol to its target.
Both continuous and gap-aware price paths are disclosed; any liquidation fails the trial.
Missing historical books, funding, membership or candles stays explicit coverage failure.
Stop-loss closes automatically; no qualifying replacement means remain closed, not resurrect a stopped bot.
Baseline actual margins plus reserve are reported separately from the 2400-USDT two-bot portfolio.
neutral_evidence: RAY: 70 grids, 140 orders, long 544 lots and short 629 lots, 17 lots per order, used 1000 plus 200 reserve; preview and post-creation states remain separate.
minimum_grid_rule: Minimum >=1 USDT over the whole range after both fill fees and contract rounding. Also report margin-per-grid leveraged return percentages. The approximate RAY 50-grid centre result does not prove a full-range floor.
range_exit_policy: Default 5% outside each edge. Latch the affected side to 1% if current inventory or monotonic fill projection cannot cover maintenance plus modeled closing fees at the stop plus a 1%-of-edge clearance. If 1% is also unsafe, close immediately. Never loosen. Gaps can still cause liquidation and fail the run.
range_selection: Causal seven-day structure, confirmed five-bar swing pivots (two closed bars on each side), ATR clipping; show supporting levels, touch counts and fallback evidence.
amendment: Dan confirmed 2400 USDT total: two bots, each 1000 used plus 200 reserve, fixed5x; radar5–10; replace worse incumbent for a better cost-adjusted grid setup; adaptive1% risk exit; restart48h evaluation only when revised paper execution actually starts.
